categories.name: Lapel Pin & Badge
commonFacts: Owner-supplied materials include zinc alloy, stainless iron, aluminum, and iron.
Back treatments include sandblasted, polished, raised or recessed metal logo, and laser marking.
Backing choices include butterfly, rubber, jewelry and deluxe clutches, magnet, safety pin, long stick pin, and screw with nut.
Standard packaging is an OPP bag; optional packaging includes a printed backing card, plastic case, and velvet box.

categories.name: Medal
commonFacts: Owner-supplied base materials include zinc alloy and iron.
Back treatments include a standard sandblasted surface plus optional polished, laser-marked, or raised-back text treatments.
Standard packaging is an OPP bag.

series.name: Carnival Medal
facts: Accessory choices include chain, twisted cord, and two-color woven ribbon with eyelet.

categories.name: Challenge Coin
commonFacts: Owner-supplied base materials for double-sided coins include zinc alloy and iron.
Edge choices include flat, 2D or 3D rope, diamond cross cut, oblique or swirl cut, spur or petal, bezel, reeded, and laser text.
Standard packaging is an OPP bag; optional packaging includes a printed card, plastic capsule, velvet box, PVC bag, velvet pouch, and wooden box.

categories.name: Key Chain
commonFacts: Owner-supplied metal keychain material is primarily zinc alloy.
Logo treatments include 3D relief, soft enamel, imitation hard enamel, printing, epoxy-domed sticker, standard laser, and black laser.
Packaging choices include OPP bag, printed card, paper box with velvet tray, cardboard box with EVA tray, window box, and velvet pouch with foil logo.
Hardware choices include round or flat rings in 25, 28, 30, 32, and 35 mm diameters, four-link chain, metal clasp, and pull ring.

series.name: Leather Keychain
facts: Materials include PU leather and genuine leather; genuine leather choices include split and top-grain leather.
Leather edges may use edge paint and the leather may be stitched.

series.name: Blank Keychain
facts: Existing molds are mainly polished blanks or blanks with an insert recess; logo treatments include epoxy-domed sticker and laser marking.

series.name: Divot Tool
facts: A divot tool usually includes an iron ball marker that can receive a custom logo.

categories.name: Belt Buckle
commonFacts: Owner-supplied base material is primarily zinc alloy.

series.name: Bottle Opener
facts: Owner-supplied materials include zinc alloy and stainless steel.

series.name: Fridge Magnet
facts: Materials include zinc alloy, soft PVC, and tinplate; backings include a metal magnet or magnetic rubber.

series.name: Cufflinks & Tie Clip
facts: Owner-supplied materials include iron and zinc alloy.
